title: Tenant Isolation & Coordinated Backoff for Escalated 5xx/Timeout Bursts
creator: Priya Shah
description: Customers experiencing concentrated 5xx and timeout spikes during tenant surges. Existing global throttles and retries amplify downstream failures. This ticket implements per-tenant isolation (circuit breakers + soft-queueing) and a coordinated, observable backoff policy to stop retry storms while preserving best-effort availability for affected tenants.
root_cause_summary: During escalations a combination of tenant burst traffic and aggressive client SDK retries caused request amplification. Global connection pools and shared KV cache pressure led to contention and increased p50/p95 latencies which in turn produced 5xx/timeouts. Lack of fine-grained per-tenant concurrency limits allowed a single tenant to consume disproportionate resources.
proposed_solution: 1) Add a per-tenant circuit breaker that trips on configurable 5xx+timeout thresholds with exponential cool-off and jitter. 2) Implement coordinated backoff header (Retry-After + X-RW-Backoff-Token) to advise clients. 3) Soft-queue requests for tripped tenants with SLA-aware dequeueing and optional model-variant fallback (smaller quantized model). 4) Adaptive per-tenant concurrency & burst tokens enforced at the router. 5) KV cache eviction prioritization by tenant criticality and TTL smoothing to avoid mass misses.
acceptance_criteria: Circuit breaker trips for a tenant after configurable window (e.g., 30s) of 5xx rate > 5% and prevents >90% of additional attempts hitting backend
Backoff header appears consistently; SDKs show exponential-jittered retries and stop amplifying traffic in load tests
Soft-queueing keeps median latency for unaffected tenants within 5% of baseline in chaos test
Model-variant fallback triggers only when tenant circuit breaker is tripped and reduces backend QPS by at least 40% in synthetic surge
Dashboards show per-tenant concurrency and a decrease in cross-tenant 5xx correlation after rollout
rollout_plan: T+0 (24h hotfix): Deploy request-router gating to apply per-tenant concurrency caps and immediate Retry-After header for flagged tenants (config flag: router.per_tenant_cap.enabled)
T+2d: Add tenant circuit breaker (runtime + config) with conservative thresholds; enable for 5% of tenants via feature flag
T+5d: Enable soft-queueing and model-variant fallback for canary group (5 tenants) + run end-to-end load tests
T+10d: Gradually ramp to 25% then 100% tenants, monitor SLOs and rollback on regressions
Post-rollout: 7-day observation window; finalize config as default or tune thresholds
monitoring_and_alerting: Dashboard: per-tenant concurrency heatmap and KV cache miss rate by tenant
SLO check: hosted-api success_rate and p95 latency across unaffected tenants must not degrade >5%
customer_communication: Initial: Targeted message to affected tenants once circuit-breaker hits, include Retry-After and recommended client SDK version that supports jittered backoff
Status page: Post incident with timeline and mitigation steps
Customer success: template for credits/compensation for customers with sustained impact > 30m
